name: Juju Way (Teamwork)
body:
You can use spirits of the unseen world to carry your spells for you.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (religion) 3 ranks, human.

Benefit(s): You can cast spells with the range of “touch” at a range of 20 feet if the recipient is a willing ally who also has this feat.
